name: fibroblast growth factor receptor 1
pathways: positive regulation of MAP kinase activity
positive regulation of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction

function.text: FGFR1 encodes fibroblast growth factor receptor 1. Annotated molecular activities include protein tyrosine kinase activity and protein homodimerization activity. It participates in positive regulation of MAP kinase activity and positive regulation of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Pfeiffer syndrome type 1 (autosomal dominant); Hartsfield-Bixler-Demyer syndrome (autosomal dominant). Additional curated associations are listed below. Postzygotic mosaic associations are recorded separately.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Lung squamous cell carcinoma; Phosphaturic mesenchymal tumor, malignant; High-grade astrocytoma with piloid features. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

function.text: FGFR1 encodes fibroblast growth factor receptor 1. It participates in positive regulation of MAP kinase activity and positive regulation of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction. Functional annotations also associate the protein with protein tyrosine kinase activity.

germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Pfeiffer syndrome type 1 (autosomal dominant); Hartsfield-Bixler-Demyer syndrome (autosomal dominant).

mosaic.text: Postzygotic mosaic variants are associated with encephalocraniocutaneous lipomatosis.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving FGFR1 have been reported in lung squamous cell carcinoma, phosphaturic mesenchymal tumor, malignant, and high-grade astrocytoma with piloid features.
